title: Intuitionism and computing with partial information
summary: There exist initial segments of both the Dyment lattice and the Dyment-Muchnik lattice that yield Brouwer algebras modeling exactly the intuitionistic propositional calculus. For the Dyment-Muchnik lattice, this result is obtained by constructing a splitting class of enumeration degrees. In contrast, the full Dyment lattice and the full Dyment-Muchnik lattice model the intuitionistic propositional calculus plus the weak law of excluded middle.
